main_text.p: tota cum ipsa Bononia, & Rauennæ exarchatus, quæ Imperatoribus diu suberat,in Rom. synagoge potestatem redactæ sint.Sed & senatorum munus (inquit Stella) quod principibus & regibus eccle-sia demandare consueuerat,ipse solus obiuit.

Aedificijs nouis Romam ornauit: & intercetera apud S. Petrum æde s percommodas ac lepo-rarium muris altissimis cinxit:in quo & ipse (Papale officium)sæpius uenationes occupabat: basilicas Petri ac Pauli,uetustate collabentes,restitu-it: & quasdam ædes in Laterano iam diu inchoa-tas, ipse perfecit. Condidit à fundamentis Sanctæ sanctorum, & Apostolorum capita argentea cap-sulis imposuit.In Missis hypocrita lachrymas fidi-& adeò Franciscanis suit,ut & Decretali episto-la,quædam ipsius factionis ambigua declarauerit. Multa ad cleri(non Christiani populi) utilitatem constituit: & ex Mendicantium ordinum fratrum lis,Cardinales plures ad Abadonis regni commo-dum secit.Notarios ac tabelliones quosdam à se-iecit:et ne magistratus ultra annum gererentur lo in loco,sub anathemate præcepit. Reprehende-batur à multis,quòd Bertholdum nepotem (spuri-um sortasis)Romandiolæ constituisset comitem:et Latinum Cardinalem,Dominicanum, nepotem sa-lium,aut nothum potius,legatum in Hetruriam mi-sset.

page.notes: Right-edge letters are clipped by the scan at several line ends (e.g. "Pa-", "ut & Decretali", "commo-", "ul", "mi-"); the reading of those clipped line ends is doubtful. "lo" at the start of the line after "gererentur" is uncertain. "suberat" and "fortasis" read as printed but are uncertain. "sortasis" may be "fortasis". The final line "sset" is partly obscured at the bottom right. Left margin marks and show-through are ignored.
